purpose: North Beach vignette production sound library

assets.prompt: Cheerful sunny North Atlantic beach ambience on a beautiful summer morning. Warm inviting waves roll gently onto sand in varied natural sets, bright sea breeze, a few pleasant distant gulls, and extremely faint happy beach activity far away with no intelligible voices. Relaxing, wholesome, spacious stereo field recording. No music, menace, storm, synthetic tones, or close voices. Perfect seamless loop for a friendly seaside game introduction.

A short warm seaside welcome chime for a friendly card game: three soft sunlit notes played on muted marimba and delicate glass, optimistic and relaxed, ending cleanly. Polished game UI sound, understated rather than childish. No orchestra, drums, voice, surf, cinematic boom, or long reverb.

Six thick premium trading cards flick and slide one by one into a neat tabletop fan at an even brisk cadence. Six distinct soft cardstock swishes with tiny papery landing taps, moving left to right. Clean close stereo game Foley, tactile, refined, and cheerful. No deck shuffle or square-up, fishing reel, fishing rod, ratchet, zipper, mechanical clicking, music, voices, surf, or ambience.

Two thick illustrated trading cards dealt one after another onto a smooth wooden table, each landing with a satisfying soft cardstock slap and tiny paper slide. Friendly polished game Foley, close and clean, moderate tempo. No shuffling, casino ambience, chips, voices, music, or background noise.

A tiny satisfying positive game confirmation made from two warm wooden notes and one subtle sunlit glass sparkle. Cheerful, tasteful, coastal, and restrained; a reward earned in a relaxing card game. Clean isolated UI sound. No coin noise, slot machine, fanfare, voice, orchestra, or long reverb.

Gentle waist-deep ocean shallows on a bright calm day, heard close to the water. Small waves lap and swirl around a swimmer, soft foam and occasional droplets, with the sunny beach now more distant. Pleasant, safe, refreshing natural stereo field recording. No voices, music, boats, storm, menace, large splashes, or synthetic sounds. Perfect seamless ambience loop.

Open ocean beyond the swimming buoy on a calm day. Broad slow swells, deep water moving beneath the listener, shoreline now far away, light wind across the surface. Beautiful and spacious but subtly lonely, with a faint sense of depth and no obvious danger. Natural cinematic stereo field recording. No music, voices, gulls, boats, storm, monster sounds, or synthetic drone. Perfect seamless loop.

A distant weathered steel navigation buoy bell rocks once on an ocean swell: one irregular hollow metallic clank with a smaller after-strike, carried across open water by wind. Real maritime field recording, slightly rusty and lonely, naturally reverberant but not musical. No foghorn, ship bell pattern, splash, voices, music, or background ambience.

A very large living shape passes beneath a listener floating at the ocean surface. Low displaced-water pressure moves smoothly from left to right, with subtle underwater turbulence and a faint body wake, ominous but ambiguous. Natural hydrodynamic sound, restrained and realistic. No roar, growl, heartbeat, music, sonar ping, splash, attack, or synthetic riser.

Subtle continuous movement inside a small weathered wooden boat on calm deep water: quiet planks lightly shifting, tiny fastener ticks, restrained timber rattles, and occasional soft structural flex. Natural close nautical Foley, gently uneasy but never dramatic, steady and sparse enough for a seamless ambience loop. No impact, engine, splash, music, voice, electronic sound, tonal bloops, breaking wood, or loose cargo. Perfect seamless loop.

A polished scene-opening Foley cue for boarding a small vintage wooden excursion boat: a gangplank settles with one warm solid knock, two measured footsteps cross onto the deck, the planks answer with a low natural flex, and one restrained brass departure bell rings softly at the end. Welcoming and tactile with faint unease. Clean close production sound. No voice, cough, engine, splash, gulls, music, boom, cargo, or breaking wood.

A small weathered wooden boat hull slowly flexes under pressure: one long low timber groan with subtle plank and fastener strain, then release. Close detailed nautical Foley, realistic and unsettling, with no impact. No splash, footsteps, objects rattling, breaking wood, music, voice, synthetic tones, or background ambience.

A small wooden excursion boat cruising slowly on deep open water. Quiet old diesel engine vibration under the deck, gentle hull movement, occasional subtle timber flex, and water washing softly along both sides. Natural immersive stereo production recording, steady enough to loop. No voices, radio, music, horn, gulls, storm, impacts, rattling cargo, or dramatic danger. Perfect seamless loop.

One clean heavy blunt thud strikes the underside of a small wooden boat. A deep rounded wooden knock with dense low-frequency weight and a very short hull-flex aftershock. Dry close production Foley, solid and physical, like something large bumped the boat from below. No splash, water, debris, cards, loose objects, repeated impacts, trailer boom, synthetic effects, music, or voices.

A sudden boat jolt makes several thick trading cards chatter, slide, and slap across a wooden deck, with one card fluttering down at the end. Detailed close stereo cardstock and wood Foley, brief and physical. No initial impact, splash, breaking wood, dice, coins, plastic, music, voice, or background ambience.

A massive ocean predator surges from deep water and violently collides with a small wooden boat at close range. Huge displaced-water splash, heavy organic impact, hull timbers splitting, deck boards cracking, debris scattering, then water and wreckage collapsing inward. Photorealistic production sound made from natural water, wood, and animal movement. Frightening and enormous. No music, trailer effects, roar, or voices.

The listener is engulfed underwater after a violent impact: surface noise collapses into a close wet rush, heavy muffled pressure, brief bubbles and debris, then sound rapidly darkens toward near silence. Visceral natural transition, not gory. No voice, heartbeat, music, roar, synthetic whoosh, explosion, or sustained ambience.

Dark quiet underwater ambience in deep coastal water after the surface chaos has passed. Distant ocean pressure, soft slow currents, occasional tiny bubbles and faint faraway hull resonance, spacious and mysterious but restrained. Natural cinematic stereo field recording with room for menu text. No music, heartbeat, sonar, whale song, voices, attack, loud creatures, or synthetic drone. Perfect seamless loop.

assets.notes: Looping background music for the final northbeach.gg welcome slide.

assets.prompt: A large shark swims past the listener underwater from left to right at moderate distance. Smooth displaced-water pressure approaches, a broad powerful body passes, then a fading tail wake and subtle bubbles. Realistic restrained hydrodynamic movement synchronized to a shadow crossing the screen. No attack, roar, growl, heartbeat, music, sonar, splash, or synthetic whoosh.

A restrained final title sting for a dark coastal mystery: one low warm wooden note, a distant muted metallic overtone, and a soft descending underwater resonance that disappears into silence. Elegant, ominous, minimal game UI sound. No orchestra, melody, drums, jump scare, trailer boom, voice, bubbles, or loud reverb.
